name: cadamcat: 1x A100-80GB vs 2x RX 7900 XT TP=2 batch-1 decode speedup ratio (vLLM)
unit: x (A100 tok/s / dual-7900XT tok/s, batch-1 decode, 500-32K ctx ladder)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (cadamcat dual-radeon-vllm, a100-vs-two-radeons). vLLM batch-1 decode, 11 context depths 500->32K, 2 rounds/cell. Stock ladder (no patches both platforms) yields A100 leading 1.36x-1.44x; the nominal BW ratio is 1.27x (2039 vs 2x800 GB/s). Fit r2>=0.9999.
notes: Headline ratio on STOCK ladder = 1.36-1.44x A100 over dual 7900 XT (reported as ~1.40x mean). The second 7900 XT card adds only 1.11-1.23x decode (bandwidth-bound step + all-reduce). Prefill is the opposite: second card buys 1.56-1.87x. Compares two consumer cards vs one used-datacenter A100 - the 'buy another one' decision.
